# Material Symbols

The outlined Material Symbols Rounded paths in `ui/AppIcons.kt` come from
[google/material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons),
revision `49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4`, under
`symbols/web/<name>/materialsymbolsrounded/<name>_24px.svg` (24px, default weight 400).

Copyright Google. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see `LICENSE.txt`.
The paths are unchanged; the vector builder translates the SVG's negative y viewport
into Compose coordinates and mirrors directional icons in right-to-left layouts.
No icon dependency is bundled.
